item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Kylie Minogue - Tension Tour // Live 2025 (1 Track Audio)
item.description:
Hi everyone!

Could somebody please share the Tension Tour Live 2025, which is released today digitally in 1 track, without losing the transition of every track. The one that's gonna be released today is split, and it loses all the excitement while listened in split tracks.

I'd like to have it full combined into one track. I tried to merge it, but, there's a glitch sound into each of the tracks. I did not merge it right.
